headword: {感覚神経|かんかくしんけい}

definitions.explanation: A nerve that carries signals from sensory receptors (in the skin, eyes, ears, etc.) to the brain and spinal cord, enabling the perception of touch, pain, temperature, sight, hearing, and other sensations.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{感覚|かんかく}→感覚：02593_kankaku⟧ (sensation, sense) and ⟦{神経|しんけい}→神経：03257_shinkei⟧ (nerve). A basic anatomy term used in biology and medicine. Sensory nerves are one of the two main types of peripheral nerves, the other being ⟦{運動神経|うんどうしんけい}→運動神経：14888_undoushinkei⟧ (motor nerves).
